title: Auf Fahrbahnen zugerannt und Widerstand geleistet – DEIG-Einsatz

extraction.summaryEn: A 29-year-old man in a mental health crisis repeatedly ran toward vehicles on Blumberger Damm and then resisted officers during transport to a hospital. A police officer used a conducted electrical weapon (DEIG) on his arm after a warning; he was not injured and was admitted to psychiatric care.
